verdict: Ads are delivering well; leads are not reaching your intake pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 178 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $12.41 — a healthy rate that has held steady within your historical range. Lead volume ticked up 2% week over week, and the final three days of the period show a strong 64% lift versus the three days prior, so ad performance is moving in the right direction. The critical issue sits downstream: your CRM shows only 146 of those 178 leads as contacts, and zero opportunities have been created from any of them, meaning leads are arriving but not being worked. SMS automation and phone access — both needed to fix contact rates — are being activated now, and getting those tools live is the immediate priority so incoming leads stop going cold.
